title: Ravana gives deadline
introduction: Ravana gives Seetha two months to marry hm. He orders ogres to frighten Seetha and bring Her to his control. Ravana then goes back to his own house with his consorts.
closing: इत्यार्षे शीर्मद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे द्वाविंशः सर्गः
Thus completes 22nd Chapter of Sundara Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
सीताय वचनं श्रुत्वा परुषं राक्षसेश्वरः |
प्रत्युवाच ततः सीतां विप्रियं प्रियदर्शनम्
verses.iast:
sītāya vacanaṃ śrutvā paruṣaṃ rākśaseśvaraḥ |
pratyuvāca tataḥ sītāṃ vipriyaṃ priyadarśanam
verses.translation: Ravana listening to Seetha's words which were harsh thereafter replied to Seetha unpleasant words which are seen to be pleasant.

glosses.meaning: which are seen to be pleasant.

verses.devanagari:
यथा यथा सान्त्वयिता वश्यः स्त्रीणां तथा तथा |
यथा यथा प्रियम् वक्ता परिBहूतस्तथा तहा
verses.iast:
yathā yathā sāntvayitā vaśyaḥ strīṇāṃ tathā tathā |
yathā yathā priyam vaktā pariBhūtastathā tahā
verses.translation: "In whatever way gentle language is used to women in that way they will be under control. In whatever way men speak dear words, in that way they will be rejected."

verses.devanagari:
संनियच्चति मे क्रोधं त्वयि कामः समुत्थितः |
द्रवतोऽमार्गमासाद्य हयानिव सुसारथिः
verses.iast:
saṃniyaccati me krodhaṃ tvayi kāmaḥ samutthitaḥ |
dravato'mārgamāsādya hayāniva susārathiḥ
verses.translation: "In your matter desire which has risen up is subdueing my anger like horses running obtaining a bad path being subdued by a good charioteer."

verses.devanagari:
वामः कामो मनुष्याणाम् यस्मिन् किल निबध्यते |
जने तस्मिंस्त्वनुक्रोशः स्नेहश्च किल जायते
verses.iast:
vāmaḥ kāmo manuṣyāṇām yasmin kila nibadhyate |
jane tasmiṃstvanukrośaḥ snehaśca kila jāyate
verses.translation: "Desire of men is unfavourable. In which man desire is tied up, in that man there is compassion and fondness."

verses.devanagari:
एतस्मात्कारणान्न त्वां घातयामि वरानने |
वधार्हमवमानार्हां मिथ्याप्रव्रजिते रताम्
verses.iast:
etasmātkāraṇānna tvāṃ ghātayāmi varānane |
vadhārhamavamānārhāṃ mithyāpravrajite ratām
verses.translation: "O one with a beautiful face! For this reason although you are suitable to be killed and suitable to be humilaited, interested in Rama who is in sham exile, I am not killing you."

glosses.meaning: O one with a beautiful face!
( in Rama who is in) sham exile

verses.devanagari:
परुषाणीह वाक्यानि यानि यानि ब्रवीषि माम् |
तेषु तेषु वधो युक्तस्तव मैथिलि दारुणः
verses.iast:
paruṣāṇīha vākyāni yāni yāni bravīṣi mām |
teṣu teṣu vadho yuktastava maithili dāruṇaḥ
verses.translation: "O Seetha! Here whatever harsh words you are speaking about me, because of those words, you are suitable to be horribly slayed."

verses.devanagari:
एकमुक्त्वा तु विअदेशीं रावणो राक्षसाधिपः |
क्रोधसंरम्भसम्युक्तः सीतामुत्तरमब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
ekamuktvā tu viadeśīṃ rāvaṇo rākśasādhipaḥ |
krodhasaṃrambhasamyuktaḥ sītāmuttaramabravīt
verses.translation: The king of ogres Ravana speaking thus to Seetha, full of anger and fury spoke subsequent word to Seetha.

verses.devanagari:
द्वौ मासौ रक्षितव्यौ मे योऽवधिस्ते मया कृतः |
ततः शयनमारोह मम त्वं वरवर्णिनि
verses.iast:
dvau māsau rakṣitavyau me yo'vadhiste mayā kṛtaḥ |
tataḥ śayanamāroha mama tvaṃ varavarṇini
verses.translation: "O Seetha with best complexion! Whatever limit has been made by me to you, those two months are protectable to me. Thereafter ascend my bed."

verses.devanagari:
ऊर्ध्वं द्वाभ्यां तु मासाभ्यां भर्तारम् मामनिच्चतीम् |
मम त्वां प्रातराशार्थमालभन्ते महानसे
verses.iast:
ūrdhvaṃ dvābhyāṃ tu māsābhyāṃ bhartāram māmaniccatīm |
mama tvāṃ prātarāśārthamālabhante mahānase
verses.translation: "Above two months you not desiring me as husband will be killed in my kitched for my breakfast."

verses.devanagari:
तां तर्ज्यमानां सम्प्रेक्ष्य राक्षसेन्द्रेण जानकीम् |
देवगन्धर्वकन्यास्ता विषेदुर्विकृतेक्षणाः
verses.iast:
tāṃ tarjyamānāṃ samprekṣya rākṣasendreṇa jānakīm |
devagandharvakanyāstā viṣedurvikṛtekṣaṇāḥ
verses.translation: Seeing Seetha being frightened by Ravana those Deva and Gandharva maidens grieved with troubled eyes.

verses.devanagari:
औष्ठप्रकारैरपरा वक्त्रनेत्रैस्तथापराः |
सीतामाश्वासयामासुस्तर्जितां तेन रक्षसा
verses.iast:
auṣṭhaprakārairaparā vaktranetraistathāparāḥ |
sītāmāśvāsayāmāsustarjitāṃ tena rakṣasā
verses.translation: Some in the way of lips and in like manner some others with faces and eyes consoled that Seetha frightened by that ogre.

verses.devanagari:
ताभिराश्वासिता सीता रावणम् राक्षसाधिपम् |
उवाचात्महितं वाक्यं वृत्तशौण्डीर्यगर्वितम्
verses.iast:
tābhirāśvāsitā sītā rāvaṇam rākṣasādhipam |
uvācātmahitaṃ vākyaṃ vṛttaśauṇḍīryagarvitam
verses.translation: Consoled by them Seetha proud of virtuous conduct spoke words beneficial to self to the king of ogres Ravana.

glosses.meaning: to the king of ogres Ravana.

verses.devanagari:
नूनम् न ते जनः कश्चिदस्ति निःश्रेयसे स्थितः |
निवारयति यो न त्वां कर्मणोऽस्माद्विगर्हितात्
verses.iast:
nūnam na te janaḥ kaścidasti niḥśreyase sthitaḥ |
nivārayati yo na tvāṃ karmaṇo'smādvigarhitāt
verses.translation: "Whoever prevents you from these actions which are blameable, such a person interested in your welfare there is none. This is definite."

glosses.meaning: there is none. nuunam = this is definite.

verses.devanagari:
मां हि धर्मात्मनः पत्नीं शचीमिव शचीपतेः |
त्वदन्यस्त्रिषु लोकेषु प्रार्थयेन्मनसापि कः
verses.iast:
māṃ hi dharmātmanaḥ patnīṃ śacīmiva śacīpateḥ |
tvadanyastriṣu lokeṣu prārthayenmanasāpi kaḥ
verses.translation: "In all the three worlds except you who even by heart will desire me who am the wife of virtuous Rama like Sachi the wife of Indra."

verses.devanagari:
राक्षसाधम रामस्य भार्याममिततेजसः |
उक्तवानसि यत्पापं क्व गतस्तस्य मोक्ष्यसे
verses.iast:
rākṣasādhama rāmasya bhāryāmamitatejasaḥ |
uktavānasi yatpāpaṃ kva gatastasya mokṣyase
verses.translation: "O vile ogre! Whatever sinful word you spoke to me who is the wife of the great resplendent Rama, from that word where will you go to be released?"

glosses.meaning: to me who is the wife

verses.devanagari:
यथा दृप्तश्च मातङ्गः शशश्च सहितौ वने |
तथा द्विरदवद्रामस्त्वं नीच शशवत् स्मृतः
verses.iast:
yathā dṛptaśca mātaṇ^gaḥ śaśaśca sahitau vane |
tathā dviradavadrāmastvaṃ nīca śaśavat smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: "Like an elephant in rut and a hare at war in the forest, in the same way O vile one! Rama is like an elephant and you are said to be like a hare."

verses.devanagari:
स त्वमिक्ष्वाकुनाथम् वै क्षिपन्निह न लज्जसे |
चक्षुषोर्विषयम् तस्य न तावदुपगच्छसि
verses.iast:
sa tvamikṣvākunātham vai kṣipanniha na lajjase |
cakṣuṣorviṣayam tasya na tāvadupagacchasi
verses.translation: "Such you are not shameful abusing the lord of Ikshvaku dynasty Rama. You are not getting Rama's matter so much."

glosses.meaning: the lord of Ikshvaku dynasty Rama

verses.devanagari:
इवे ते नयने क्रूते विरूपे कृष्णपिङ्गले |
क्षितौ न पतिते कस्मान्मामनार्य निरीक्षतः
verses.iast:
ive te nayane krūte virūpe kṛṣṇapiṇ^gale |
kṣitau na patite kasmānmāmanārya nirīkṣataḥ
verses.translation: "O ignoble one! your these eyes which are cruel, crooked, which are black and reddish brown, which are seeing me, for what reason are they not falling down."

glosses.meaning: which are black and reddish brown

verses.devanagari:
तस्य धर्मात्मनः पत्नीं स्नुषां दशरथस्य च |
कथं व्याहरतो मां ते न जिह्वा व्यवशीर्यते
verses.iast:
tasya dharmātmanaḥ patnīṃ snuṣāṃ daśarathasya ca |
kathaṃ vyāharato māṃ te na jihvā vyavaśīryate
verses.translation: "Thus speaking about me who am the wife of virtuous Rama and the daughter-in-law of Dasaratha how your tongue did not fall off."

verses.devanagari:
असंदेशात्तु रामस्य तपसश्चामपालनात् |
न त्वां कुर्मि दशग्रीव भस्म भर्मार्ह तेजसा
verses.iast:
asandeśāttu rāmasya tapasaścāmapālanāt |
na tvāṃ kurmi daśagrīva bhasma bharmārha tejasā
verses.translation: "O Ravana! Although you are suited to be burnt into ashes, not having the mandate of Rama and preserving austerity, I am not reducing you into ashes with my glory."

glosses.meaning: (although you are) suited to be burnt into ashes

verses.devanagari:
नापहर्तुमहं शक्या त्वया रामस्य धीमतः |
विधिस्तव वधार्थाय विहितो नात्र संशयः
verses.iast:
nāpahartumahaṃ śakyā tvayā rāmasya dhīmataḥ |
vidhistava vadhārthāya vihito nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: "Wise Rama's I am not capable of being abducted by you. This act has been made for your slaying. In this there is no doubt."

verses.devanagari:
शूरेण धनदभ्रात्रा बलैः समुदितेन च |
अपिह्य रामं कस्माद्धि दारचौर्यं त्वया कृतम्
verses.iast:
śūreṇa dhanadabhrātrā balaiḥ samuditena ca |
apihya rāmaṃ kasmāddhi dāracauryaṃ tvayā kṛtam
verses.translation: "By you who is strong, brother of Kubera possessed of army, removing Rama for what reason abduction of wife has been done."

verses.devanagari:
सीताया वचनं श्रुत्वा रावणो राक्षसाधिपः |
विनृत्य नयने क्रूरे जानकीमन्ववैक्षत
verses.iast:
sītāyā vacanaṃ śrutvā rāvaṇo rākṣasādhipaḥ |
vinṛtya nayane krūre jānakīmanvavaikṣata
verses.translation: King of rakshasas Ravana listening to Seetha's words turned around his cruel eyes and saw Seetha.

verses.devanagari:
नीलजीमूतसम्काशो महाभुजशिरोधरः |
सिंहसत्त्वगतिः श्रीमान् दीप्त जिह्वग्रलोचनः
verses.iast:
nīlajīmūtasamkāśo mahābhujaśirodharaḥ |
siṃhasattvagatiḥ śrīmān dīpta jihvagralocanaḥ
verses.translation: Ravana was qual to a black cloud, with big shoulders and neck with the strength and gait of a lion, glorious with radiant tip of tongue and eyes.

glosses.meaning: (Ravana was) equal to a black cloud
with the strength and gait of a lion
with radiant tip of tongue and eyes.

verses.devanagari:
चलाग्रमकुटप्रांशुश्चित्रमाल्यानुलेपनः |
रक्तमाल्याम्बरधरस्तप्ताङ्गदविभूषणः
verses.iast:
calāgramakuṭaprāṃśuścitramālyānulepanaḥ |
raktamālyāmbaradharastaptāṇ^gadavibhūṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: He was tall with moving front portion of crown, with excellent garlands and anointments, wearing red garlands and clothes, with ornaments made of refined gold.

glosses.meaning: (He was) tall with moving front portion of crown
with ornaments made of refined gold

verses.devanagari:
श्रोणिसूत्रेण महता मेचकेन सुसम्वृतः |
अमृतोत्पादनद्धेन भुजगेनेव मन्दरः
verses.iast:
śroṇisūtreṇa mahatā mecakena susamvṛtaḥ |
amṛtotpādanaddhena bhujageneva mandaraḥ
verses.translation: Like Mount Mandara tied by Vasuki for producing nectar, Ravana was well tied by a black big thread.

verses.devanagari:
ताभ्यां स परिपूर्णाभ्यां भुजाभ्यां राक्षसेश्वरः |
शुशुभेऽचलसंकाशः शृङ्गाभ्यामिव मन्दरः
verses.iast:
tābhyāṃ sa paripūrṇābhyāṃ bhujābhyāṃ rākṣaseśvaraḥ |
śuśubhe'calasaṅkāśaḥ śṛṇ^gābhyāmiva mandaraḥ
verses.translation: Equalling a mountain the king of ogres shone with those perfect shoulders like Mount Mandara with its peaks.

verses.devanagari:
तरुणादित्यवर्णाभ्यां कुण्डलाभ्यां विभूषितः |
रक्तपल्लवपुष्पाभ्यामशोकाभ्यामिवाचलः
verses.iast:
taruṇādityavarṇābhyāṃ kuṇḍalābhyāṃ vibhūṣitaḥ |
raktapallavapuṣpābhyāmaśokābhyāmivācalaḥ
verses.translation: With the color of just risen sun, decorated by earrings, he was like a mountain with Ashoka trees with red flowers and shoots.

glosses.meaning: With the color of just risen sun

verses.devanagari:
स कल्पवृक्षप्रतिमो वसन्त इव मूर्तिमान् |
श्मशानचैत्यप्रतिमो भूषितोऽपि भयम्करः
verses.iast:
sa kalpavṛkṣapratimo vasanta iva mūrtimān |
śmaśānacaityapratimo bhūṣito'pi bhayamkaraḥ
verses.translation: Equalling a Kalpavriksha he was like the embodiment of spring season. Like a funeral mound in a grave-yard was horrible even though decorated.

glosses.meaning: was like the embodiment of spring
like a funeral mound in a grave-yard

verses.devanagari:
अवेक्षमाणो वैदेहीं कोपसम्रक्तलोचनः |
उवाच रावणः सीतां भुजङ्ग इव निःश्वसन्
verses.iast:
avekṣamāṇo vaidehīṃ kopasamraktalocanaḥ |
uvāca rāvaṇaḥ sītāṃ bhujaṇ^ga iva niḥśvasan
verses.translation: With red eyes due to anger Ravana was looking at Seetha sighing like a serpant and spoke to Seetha.

glosses.meaning: With red eyes due to anger

verses.devanagari:
अनयेनाभिसम्पन्नमर्थहीनमनुव्रते |
नाशयाम्यहमद्य त्वां सूर्यः सन्ध्यामिवौजसा
verses.iast:
anayenābhisampannamarthahīnamanuvrate |
nāśayāmyahamadya tvāṃ sūryaḥ sandhyāmivaujasā
verses.translation: O foloower of Rama posessing bad conduct, without wealth! Now I will destroy you like sun destroying morning twilight with light.

verses.devanagari:
इत्युक्त्वा मैथिलीम् राजा रावणः शत्रुरावणः |
संदिदेश ततः सर्वा राक्षसीर्गोरदर्शनाः
verses.iast:
ityuktvā maithilīm rājā rāvaṇaḥ śatrurāvaṇaḥ |
saṃdideśa tataḥ sarvā rākṣasīrgoradarśanāḥ
verses.translation: The king Ravana who causes enemies to cry thus speaking to Seetha, thereafter ordered all ogre women with horrible appearances.

verses.devanagari:
एकाक्षीमेककर्णां च कर्णप्रावरणां तथा |
गोकर्णीं हस्तिकर्णीम् च लम्बकर्णीमकर्णिकाम्
हस्तिपाद्यश्वपाद्यौ च गोपादीं पादचूळिकाम् |
एकाक्षीमेकपादीं च पृथुपादीमपादिकाम्
अतिमात्रशिरोग्रीवामतिमात्रकुचोदरीम् |
अतिमात्रास्यनेत्राम् च दीर्घजिह्वमजिह्विकाम्
अनासिकां सिम्हमुखीं गोमुखीम् सूकरीमुखीम् |
verses.iast:
ekākṣīmekakarṇāṃ ca karṇaprāvaraṇāṃ tathā |
gokarṇīṃ hastikarṇīm ca lambakarṇīmakarṇikām
hastipādyaśvapādyau ca gopādīṃ pādacūLikām |
ekākṣīmekapādīṃ ca pṛthupādīmapādikām
atimātraśirogrīvāmatimātrakucodarīm |
atimātrāsyanetrām ca dīrghajihvamajihvikām
anāsikāṃ simhamukhīṃ gomukhīm sūkarīmukhīm |
verses.translation: Ravana ordered one with a single eye, one with a single ear and one with ears as covering, one with cow's wars, one with ears of an elephant, one with dangling ears, one without ears and one with the feet of an elephant and one with the feet of a horse, one with feet of a cow,one with hair over feet, one with a single eye and one with a single foot, one with big feet, one without feet, one with a big head and neck,one with big breasts and stomach, and one with big mouth and eyes, one with a long tongue, one without tongue, one without nose, one with the face of a lion, one with the face of a cow,one with the face of a pig.

glosses.meaning: (Ravana ordered) one with a singe eye
one with ears of an elephant
and one with the feet of an elephant and one with feet of a horse
one with feet of a cow
one with hair over the feet
and one with a single foot
one with a big head and neck
one with big breats and stomach
and one with big mouth and eyes
one with the face of a lion
one with the face of a cow
one with the face of a pig.

verses.devanagari:
यथा मद्वशगा सीता क्ष्प्रं भवति जानकी
तथा कुरुत राक्षस्यः सर्वाः क्षिप्रं समेत्य च |
verses.iast:
yathā madvaśagā sītā kṣpraṃ bhavati jānakī
tathā kuruta rākṣasyaḥ sarvāḥ kṣipraṃ sametya ca |
verses.translation: "O ogres! How the daughter of Janaka, Seetha becomes under my control quickly, thus all of you together do that task."

verses.devanagari:
प्रतिलोमानुलोमैश्च सामदानादिभेदनैः
अवर्जयत वैदेहीं दण्डस्योद्यमनेन च |
verses.iast:
pratilomānulomaiśca sāmadānādibhedanaiḥ
avarjayata vaidehīṃ daṇḍasyodyamanena ca |
verses.translation: "With hostile and favourable tasks, with kind words, with gifts and dividing words and exertion of punishment, bring Seetha under my possession."

verses.devanagari:
इति प्रतिसमादिश्य राक्षसेन्द्रः पुनः पुनः
काममन्युपरीतात्मा जानकीं पर्यतर्जयत् |
verses.iast:
iti pratisamādiśya rākṣasendraḥ punaḥ punaḥ
kāmamanyuparītātmā jānakīṃ paryatarjayat |
verses.translation: Ravana thus ordered again and again with a mind full of lust and anger frightened Seetha.

glosses.meaning: with a mind full of lust and anger

verses.devanagari:
उपगम्य ततः शीघ्रं राक्षसी धान्यमालिनी
परिष्वज्य दशग्रीवमिदं वचनमब्रवीत् |
verses.iast:
upagamya tataḥ śīghraṃ rākṣasī dhānyamālinī
pariṣvajya daśagrīvamidaṃ vacanamabravīt |
verses.translation: Thereafter an ogre named Dhanyamalini quickly neared Ravana, embraced him and spoke these words.

verses.devanagari:
मया क्रीड महाराज सीतया किं तवानया
विवर्णया कृपणया मानुष्या राक्षसेश्वर |
verses.iast:
mayā krīḍa mahārāja sītayā kiṃ tavānayā
vivarṇayā kṛpaṇayā mānuṣyā rākṣaseśvara |
verses.translation: "O king! Sport with me. O lord of ogres! Of what use to you is this Seetha who is colorless and a wreched human."

verses.devanagari:
नूनमस्या महाराज न दिव्यान् भोगसत्तमान्
विदधात्यमरश्रेष्ठस्तव बाहुबलार्जितान् |
verses.iast:
nūnamasyā mahārāja na divyān bhogasattamān
vidadhātyamaraśreṣṭhastava bāhubalārjitān |
verses.translation: "O king! Lord Barhma did not assign to Her wonderful best luxuries earned by the might of your arms. This is definite."

glosses.meaning: earned by the might of your arms

verses.devanagari:
अकामां कामयानस्य शरीरमुपतप्यते
इच्छन्तीं कामयानस्य प्रीतिर्भवति शोभना |
verses.iast:
akāmāṃ kāmayānasya śarīramupatapyate
icchantīṃ kāmayānasya prītirbhavati śobhanā |
verses.translation: "The body of one who desires a woman without desire suffers pain. Good happiness will occur to one who loves a woman who desires him."

verses.devanagari:
एवमुक्तस्तु राक्षस्या समुत्क्षिप्तस्ततो बली
प्रहसन्मेघसम्काशो राक्षसः स न्यवर्तत |
verses.iast:
evamuktastu rākṣasyā samutkṣiptastato balī
prahasanmeghasamkāśo rākṣasaḥ sa nyavartata |
verses.translation: Thus spoken to by that ogre that Ravana who was strong equalling a cloud, thereafter being taken away turned back laughing."

verses.devanagari:
प्रस्थितः स दशग्रीवः कम्पयन्निव मेदिनीम्
ज्वलद्भास्करवर्णाभम् प्रविवेश निवेशनम् |
verses.iast:
prasthitaḥ sa daśagrīvaḥ kampayanniva medinīm
jvaladbhāskaravarṇābham praviveśa niveśanam |
verses.translation: That Ravana departing was as though shaking the earth and entered his house with the lustre of blazing sun shine.

glosses.meaning: (his) house jvaladbhaaskaravarNaabham = with the lustre of blazing sun shine

verses.devanagari:
देवगन्धर्वकन्याश्च नागकन्याश्च सर्वतः
परिवार्य दशग्रीवं विविशुस्तं गृहोत्तमम् |
verses.iast:
devagandharvakanyāśca nāgakanyāśca sarvataḥ
parivārya daśagrīvaṃ viviśustaṃ gṛhottamam |
verses.translation: Deva and Gandharva maidens and Naga maidens surrounding Ravana in all directions entered that best among houses.

verses.devanagari:
स मैथिलीं ध्रम परामवस्थितां |
प्रवेपमानां परिभर्स्य रावणः |
विहाय सीतां मदनेन मोहितः |
स्वमेव वेश्म प्रविवेश भास्वरम्
verses.iast:
sa maithilīṃ dhrama parāmavasthitāṃ |
pravepamānāṃ paribharsya rāvaṇaḥ |
vihāya sītāṃ madanena mohitaḥ |
svameva veśma praviveśa bhāsvaram
verses.translation: That Ravana frightening Seetha who was steadfastly intent on virtue and who was shaking, leaving Seetha, infatuated by love, entered his own house which was shining.
